analysis.summary: Site.ts uses app.name instead of featureAppName from AppConfig, causing path mismatches with BffApi routes and S3 assets.

bugs.title: Path mismatch due to app.name vs featureAppName inconsistency
bugs.description: Site.ts constructs baseUrl and privateBaseUrl using app.name instead of featureAppName from AppConfig, while BffApi.ts uses featureAppName for API routes and webpack uses it for asset paths. This causes CloudFront behaviors to forward requests to incorrect paths that don't exist in API Gateway, and prevents S3 from serving feature-app assets.
bugs.risk: API requests will fail with 404 errors due to route mismatch between CloudFront behaviors (/__app__/${app.name}/...) and API Gateway routes (/__app__/${featureAppName}/...). Additionally, feature-app assets will be unreachable if app.name differs from featureAppName.

notBugs.topic: Removal of pathRewrite in webpack dev server
notBugs.reason: The pathRewrite was correctly removed because the BFF API now expects the full baseUrl path prefix in the route (ANY ${baseUrl}/bff/{proxy+}), so the proxy must forward the full path instead of stripping it.

notBugs.topic: Removal of CloudFront function for HTML extensions
notBugs.reason: While this changes behavior for clean URLs, the diff does not provide enough context to confirm if S3 static website hosting or other mechanisms are now handling index.html resolution, or if the application structure changed to not require extension-less URLs.
